review_evidence: README describes the project solely as a Lean 4 library for ANSI-colored terminal output.

Complete inspection of the three primary Lean files shows terminal Section/Color/Style datatypes, a Colorized String instance, an IO printing example, and Lake configuration; there are zero theorem, lemma, axiom or example declarations.
The source provides presentation utilities only and contains no independent specification, proof, or formal semantics.
